name: projects-emergence
description: An Agent Skill that applies academic research methods to reproducible, reflective, and publishable project and product development.

interface.shortDescription: Apply research methods to evidence-backed projects.
interface.longDescription: Develop projects and products through prior-work research, replication, testable hypotheses, evidence gates, minimal experiments, reflection, and revision.
defaultPrompt: I have a project idea. Help me research it before we build.
Turn this rough idea into a small, testable project.
Review this project and decide what evidence is still missing.
